== Description ==

[[Barry Alperstein]] (right, olive MORDOR tee, beard, watch, name tag, looking at cards) and [[Joe Olson]] (left, reddish beard, glasses, grey tee, back and side to the camera) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
